01

“And among the people is he who buys idle talk [lahw al-hadith]”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 31:6).

766
Explanation from Mujāhid No. 766: 1: 4

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
766: 1:4. Sufyan, from Habib ibn Abi Thabit, from Mujahid, on His words
"And among the people is he who buys idle talk [lahw al-hadith]": He said, singing (verse 6).
العربية
766: 1: 4 سفيان عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ فِي قَوْلِهِ وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يَشْتَرِي لَهْوَ الْحَدِيثِ قال الغناء (الآية 6) .
Edition record 371477 · p. 238Link to report ↗
767
Report from Mujāhid No. 767: 2: 5

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
767: 2:5. Sufyan, from Abd al-Karim, from Mujahid, who said:
It is singing and every kind of idle play.
العربية
767: 2: 5 سفيان عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ قَالَ هُوَ الْغِنَاءُ وَكُلُّ لَعِبٍ لهو.
Edition record 371477 · p. 238Link to report ↗
02

“the most unpleasant of sounds is the voice of donkeys”

An explanation transmitted from al-Aʿmash (Q 31:19).

768
Explanation from al-Aʿmash No. 768: 3: 2

al-Aʿmash

English
Transmission wording
768: 3:2. Sufyan, from al-Amash, on His words
"the most unpleasant of sounds is the voice of donkeys": He said, the ugliest of sounds (verse 19).
العربية
768: 3: 2 سفيان عن الأعمش في قوله أنكر الأصوات لصوت الحمير قال أقبح الأصوات (الآية 19) .
Edition record 371477 · p. 238Link to report ↗
03

“and He has lavished upon you His favors, apparent and hidden”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 31:20).

769
Explanation from Mujāhid No. 769: 4: 1

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
769: 4:1. Sufyan, from Humayd al-Araj, from Mujahid, on His words
"and He has lavished upon you His favors, apparent and hidden": He said, there is no god but God (verse 20).
العربية
769: 4: 1 سفيان عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ الْأَعْرَجِ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ فِي قَوْلِهِ وَأَسْبَغَ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعَمَهُ ظاهرة وباطنه قَالَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ (الآية 20) .
Edition record 371477 · p. 238Link to report ↗
04

Verse 34

An explanation transmitted from Ibn ʿUmar (Q 31:34).

770
Explanation from Ibn ʿUmar No. 770: 5: 3

Ibn ʿUmar

English
Transmission wording
770: 5:3. Sufyan, from Abd Allah ibn Dinar, from Ibn Umar, who said:
The Messenger of God, peace be upon him, said: "The keys of the unseen are five that none knows except God, Mighty and Majestic: No one knows when the Hour will come; no one knows what the wombs diminish; no one knows what will happen tomorrow; no soul knows in which land it will die, except God; and no one knows when the rain will fall, except God" (verse 34).
العربية
770: 5: 3 سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دينار عن بن عُمَرَ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَفَاتِيحُ الْغَيْبِ خَمْسٌ لَا يَعْلَمُهُنَّ إِلَّا اللَّهُ عز وجل لَا يُعْلَمُ مَتَى السَّاعَةُ وَلَا يُعْلَمُ مَا تَغِيضُ الأَرْحَامُ وَلَا يُعْلَمُ مَا في غد ولا يعلم نفسا بِأَيِّ أَرْضٍ تَمُوتُ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَلَا يَعْلَمُ أَحَدٌ مَتَى يَنْزِلُ الغيث إلا الله (الآية 34) .
